questions.code_template:
n = 5
a = 28
b = 8
nums = [28, 8, 29, 10, 27]
word = 'beta'
case_tag = 29223
records = [{'type':'A','v':a}, {'type':'B','v':b}, {'type':'A','v':n}]
result = ___
print(case_tag, result)
questions.hints: 按记录类型分组求和
questions.solution:
n = 5
a = 28
b = 8
nums = [28, 8, 29, 10, 27]
word = 'beta'
case_tag = 29223
records = [{'type':'A','v':a}, {'type':'B','v':b}, {'type':'A','v':n}]
result = {kind:sum(r['v'] for r in records if r['type']==kind) for kind in ('A','B')}
print(case_tag, result)

questions.topic: 命令行工具与综合项目
questions.description: shlex 带空格值：请根据代码注释及变量，补全 ___ 处的关键表达式或语句，使程序输出正确的计算结果。
questions.code_template:
n = 1
a = 16
b = 4
nums = [16, 4, 17, 6, 15]
word = 'vector'
case_tag = 29225
import shlex
command = 'tool --title "' + word + ' item" --count ' + str(n)
result = ___
print(case_tag, result)
questions.hints: 引号允许命令参数包含空格
questions.solution:
n = 1
a = 16
b = 4
nums = [16, 4, 17, 6, 15]
word = 'vector'
case_tag = 29225
import shlex
command = 'tool --title "' + word + ' item" --count ' + str(n)
result = shlex.split(command)
print(case_tag, result)
